question: Ram invested a certain sum of money at simple interest. It amounted to (5/4) of itself in 3 years. What will be its rate per cent per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Ram invested a certain sum of money at simple interest.

It amounted to 5/4 of itself in 3 years.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Let the Principal be P.

Amount after 3 years = (5)/(4) × P&
